dialogue.content: （本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: （こんにちは。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。まず、年齢、性別、本日の相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 14才、女、男子がいやです
dialogue.English: 14 years old, female, and I dislike boys.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうござます。男子が嫌なのですね。14歳ということは中学生さんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. So you dislike boys. You're 14, does that mean you're in middle school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 男子もいる共学の学校ですか？
dialogue.English: Is it a co-ed school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それでは、男子が嫌という状況は少し困りますね、、具体的にどんなふうに嫌か教えてもらえますか？話せるところからで大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, disliking boys must be a bit difficult for you. Could you tell me more specifically what you dislike about them? You can start with whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: 学校でも、塾でも、わたしって男子から嫌われるのかなっておもうことがあって・・・
dialogue.English: At school and at cram school, I sometimes think that the boys might dislike me...

dialogue.content: いじめかもしれない
dialogue.English: It might be bullying.

dialogue.content: いじめかもしれないと感じているのですね。それはつらいですね。。どんな時にそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: You feel like it might be bullying. That must be very painful. When do you feel that way?

dialogue.content: わたしの名前をいれた歌をうたわれたり
dialogue.English: They sing songs with my name in them.

dialogue.content: うんうん、他にもありますか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, is there anything else?

dialogue.content: テストでいい点をとったとき先生が私の名前をだしたりすると、男子が変なリアクションしたり
dialogue.English: When I get a good score on a test and the teacher mentions my name, the boys have strange reactions.

dialogue.content: うわばきが下駄箱に奥にぐちゃってつっこまれてたり
dialogue.English: My indoor shoes get shoved messily to the back of the shoe locker.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったんですね。それは嫌な気持ちになりますね。教えてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: So those things have happened. That must feel awful. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそのようなことが始まりましたか？
dialogue.English: When did things like that start happening?

dialogue.content: うん、すごくいやで。学校は行きたくないけどなんとかいってる。
dialogue.English: Yeah, I really hate it. I don't want to go to school, but I'm managing to go somehow.

dialogue.content: ２年生になってからかな
dialogue.English: Probably since I started my second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: 私立の進学校にいってればこういうのなかったのかも
dialogue.English: Maybe this wouldn't have happened if I had gone to a private college prep school.

dialogue.content: つらいけど頑張って行ってるんだね。よく頑張っていますね。
dialogue.English: It's tough, but you're doing your best to go. You're doing really well.

dialogue.content: うん、学校も部活も塾もぜんぶ休まずいってる
dialogue.English: Yeah, I haven't missed a day of school, club activities, or cram school.

dialogue.content: それはすごいね！嫌な気持ちのなか、全部頑張ってるんですね。それだけでも自分を褒めて良いと相談員は思います。
dialogue.English: That's amazing! You're trying so hard with everything despite these awful feelings. I think you should praise yourself just for that.

dialogue.content: ありがとう、でももうイヤだ。悪いことしてないのに。
dialogue.English: Thank you, but I'm sick of it. I haven't done anything wrong.

dialogue.content: 最近はわざと学校のテストで一番にならないように間違えたりしてる
dialogue.English: Lately, I've been intentionally getting answers wrong on school tests so I don't get the top score.

dialogue.content: 目立つと男子がいやなこと言うから
dialogue.English: Because when I stand out, the boys say mean things.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、嫌な気持ちにもなるしそれが続くとしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand, it makes you feel bad, and it must be exhausting when it keeps happening.

dialogue.content: テストで一番にならないようにと考えてしまうほど嫌な気持ちがあるんだね。テストで一番って本当は嬉しいことなのに、つらいね。。
dialogue.English: You feel so bad that you're even thinking about not coming in first on tests. Getting the top score should be something to be happy about, so that must be painful.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなことができるか一緒に考えていきましょう！みかさんは学校の成績が良くてクラスでも目立つのかな？
dialogue.English: Let's think together about what we can do today! Is it that you stand out in class because you have good grades?

dialogue.content: うん、学校でも塾でも成績はトップ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m at the top both at school and at cram school.

dialogue.content: でも塾でも男子に嫌味いわれる。塾の男子は別の学校だけど
dialogue.English: But even at cram school, boys make snide remarks. The boys there are from different schools, though.

dialogue.content: 勉強も頑張ってるんだね。塾と学校の男子はそれぞれ違うけど、両方で嫌がらせを感じるのかな？
dialogue.English: You're working hard on your studies, too. So, the boys at cram school and at your school are different, but you feel harassed in both places?

dialogue.content: 塾で嫌がらせみたいに感じるのは、言葉だけかな。
dialogue.English: At cram school, what feels like harassment is just words, I guess.

dialogue.content: 学校の男子は、言葉だけでなくわたしのうわばきとかだぶんいじってる。
dialogue.English: At school, the boys do more than just say things; they probably mess with my indoor shoes.

dialogue.content: 男子が嫌なこというと、クスクスおもしろがって笑う女子もいてイヤだ
dialogue.English: When the boys say mean things, I hate that there are also girls who snicker and laugh like it's funny.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、、うわばきにイタズラされるとか嫌な気分になるね。女の子も男子の嫌がらせに乗ることもあるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see... Having your indoor shoes messed with must be upsetting. And some of the girls join in on the boys' harassment too.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、仲の良い女の子の友達とかはいますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, do you have any close female friends?

dialogue.content: 仲の良い友達は一応いるけど
dialogue.English: I do have close friends, kind of, but...

dialogue.content: わたしの悩みはわかってくれないと思う。
dialogue.English: I don't think they would understand my worries.

dialogue.content: 休み時間とか一緒にいる友達はいる
dialogue.English: I have friends I hang out with during breaks.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、それは少し安心ですね。ただ、友達は悩みはわかってくれないと思うんですね。なぜそう思うのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, that's a bit reassuring. But you think your friends wouldn't understand your worries. Why do you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 成績がよくて目立つのがイヤでわざと間違えるって話は友達にはできないから
dialogue.English: Because I can't tell my friends that I deliberately make mistakes because I hate standing out for my good grades.

dialogue.content: 自慢してる、いい気になってるって思われちゃう
dialogue.English: They’d think I’m bragging or full of myself.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだよね、成績が良いこそのつらさもあるんだね。学校の先生やご両親、大人の人に話したことはあるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. So there's a kind of pain that comes specifically from having good grades. Have you ever talked to your teachers at school, your parents, or any other adults about this?

dialogue.content: 親には話したし、担任の先生にも親をとおして話した
dialogue.English: I told my parents, and they talked to my homeroom teacher.

dialogue.content: でも何も変わらない
dialogue.English: But nothing has changed.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。勇気を出して相談したんだね。でも状況は変わらないと、、、それは悲しいね。
dialogue.English: I see. It took courage to reach out. But the situation hasn’t changed—that’s disheartening.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 先生は「人を傷つけることを言うのはやめよう」って学活の時間に言っただけ
dialogue.English: The teacher just said, "Let's stop saying things that hurt people," during homeroom.

dialogue.content: 私が気づいてほしい男子たちはたぶん自分たちのことだってわかってない
dialogue.English: The boys I want to get the message probably don't realize it's about them.

dialogue.content: でも私が先生に言ったってことが男子にわかるのも厄介だから仕方ない
dialogue.English: But it would be troublesome if the boys found out I told the teacher, so I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、それじゃ気付かないかもね、、みかさん自身がその子達に「イヤだ、やめて」といったことはあるかな？
dialogue.English: I see—then they might not realize. Have you ever told them yourself, “I don’t like that. Please stop”?

dialogue.content: ない。
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、それはかなり勇気がいることだもんね。
dialogue.English: I understand—that takes a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: うわばきとかは証拠はないし。
dialogue.English: And there’s no proof about the indoor shoes and things like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。さっき、私立の学校の話が出たけど、受験という選択肢もあったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned private schools earlier. Was taking the entrance exam for one an option for you?

dialogue.content: 一応。お兄ちゃんはめちゃ頭よくて中学受験した
dialogue.English: It was an option. My older brother is super smart and took the entrance exams for middle school.

dialogue.content: 私も受験したいかきかれたけど、
dialogue.English: I was asked if I wanted to take the exams too, but...

dialogue.content: そのときは、お兄ちゃんと同じレベルにいけるとは思えなくて、
dialogue.English: at the time, I didn't think I could get to the same level as my brother,

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 比べられるのがいやで、受験はしないことにした
dialogue.English: I didn't like the idea of being compared, so I decided not to take the exams.

dialogue.content: でも、いまとなっては、結構勉強はできるから私立にいっておけば成績がよいことで悩むことはなかったかも
dialogue.English: But now, I'm actually pretty good at studying, so maybe if I had gone to a private school, I wouldn't have had to worry about having good grades.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、比べられるのがいやだったんだね。でも今は成績が良いことで悩むのがつらいんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. You didn't want to be compared. But now, you're struggling because you have good grades.

dialogue.content: うん。私立だと成績順にクラスもわけられるし、先生からもいい扱いをうけられるみたい
dialogue.English: Yeah. At private schools, classes are apparently divided by grades, and teachers treat high achievers well.

dialogue.content: 今の学校はその逆。
dialogue.English: My current school is the opposite.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。成績が良いみかさんにとって少し居心地が悪い環境になってしまってるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So for you, with your good grades, it's become a somewhat uncomfortable environment.

dialogue.content: 少しじゃなくて、かなり居心地悪い
dialogue.English: Not just somewhat, it's very uncomfortable.

dialogue.content: そかそか、かなり、だね。みかさんにとって今一番つらいことはなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see, very uncomfortable. What is the most painful thing for you right now?

dialogue.content: 男子に何か言われた時、胸やお腹がいやな感じになる
dialogue.English: When boys say something to me, I get a bad feeling in my chest and stomach.

dialogue.content: くるしくなる
dialogue.English: My chest feels tight.

dialogue.content: 苦しくなるんだね。。つらいね。。
dialogue.English: Your chest feels tight... that must be so hard.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 早く卒業したい
dialogue.English: I just want to graduate soon.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そう思ってしますよね。。塾で言われるより学校で言われる方がいやな状況かな？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's natural to feel that way. Is the situation worse when things are said at school compared to at cram school?

dialogue.content: （すみません、思って「しまう」です。↑）
dialogue.English: (Sorry—I meant “I end up feeling that way.”)

dialogue.content: うん、学校のほうがいや。塾の方が成績いいことで先生は可愛がってくれるし
dialogue.English: Yes, school is worse. At cram school, the teachers favor me because my grades are good.

dialogue.content: （大丈夫です）
dialogue.English: (It's okay.)

dialogue.content: 塾の方が女の子の友達と気が合うから大丈夫
dialogue.English: I get along better with my female friends at cram school, so it's okay there.

dialogue.content: うんうん、塾より学校が嫌なんだね。学校では、今わざと成績落とすようなこともしてるって言ってたけど、本当はそんなことしたくないと思ってるのかな？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so you dislike school more than cram school. You mentioned that you're intentionally letting your grades drop at school, but do you really not want to be doing that?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: なんでこんなことしてるんだろう、って思っちゃう
dialogue.English: I find myself wondering, "Why am I doing this?"

dialogue.content: そうだよね。なんだか悲しくなるよね。ちなみに、男子が嫌がらせをするのは成績のことだけかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. It's sad, isn't it? By the way, is the harassment from the boys only about your grades?

dialogue.content: ピアノとか字とか絵とかも表彰されたりよくしてるから、目立った時、って感じかな。
dialogue.English: I also often get awards for things like piano, calligraphy, and art, so I guess it's whenever I stand out.

dialogue.content: なるほど、目立った時に嫌がらせを受ける感じがあるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel like you're harassed whenever you stand out.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 男子の嫌がらせがなくなれば学校行くのもいやじゃなくなりそうかな？
dialogue.English: If the boys’ harassment stopped, do you think you’d feel less reluctant about going to school?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもわからない。
dialogue.English: But I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: わからない、と思うのはなんでかな？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel unsure?

dialogue.content: 他にも私のこと良くない目でみてる人いそう
dialogue.English: I feel like there are other people who look at me in a negative way.

dialogue.content: 今は、その男子たちが私に嫌がらせをすることで
dialogue.English: Right now, because those boys harass me,

dialogue.content: 内心気持ちよくおもっている女子もいそうだから
dialogue.English: some girls might secretly feel pleased about it.

dialogue.content: そう思うんだね。。
dialogue.English: That’s how it seems to you...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 男子がなにか言ってるときにやにやしてる女子がいるから
dialogue.English: Because there are girls who are smirking when the boys say something.

dialogue.content: うんうん。色々教えてくれてありがとう。ここまでお話しを聞いて、みかさんはとても優秀で、その上頑張って学校に行ったり大人の人にも勇気を出して相談することができる人だと思います。それは素晴らしいことだし、自信を持って欲しいと思います。ただ、目立つが故にそれをよく思わない人も、悲しいことにいるのも事実で、それを感じてしまっているのだと思います。相談員としては、もう少し周りの大人たちにみかさんのことを助けて欲しいと思うのですが、ご両親や担任の先生以外にお話しできそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Thank you for telling me so much. From what I've heard so far, I think you are very talented, and on top of that, you're a person who can push yourself to go to school and find the courage to talk to adults. That's a wonderful thing, and I want you to be confident about it. However, it's also a sad fact that because you stand out, there are people who don't feel good about it, and I believe that's what you're sensing. As a counselor, I'd like the adults around you to help you a little more. Is there anyone you could talk to other than your parents or your homeroom teacher?

dialogue.content: うーん、わからない。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: 親も先生も結局なにも変えられない
dialogue.English: In the end, neither my parents nor my teacher can change anything.

dialogue.content: そうかそうか。そうだよね、そう思ってしまうよね。。例えば、今から編入するという選択肢もあったりするのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. It's understandable that you would feel that way. For example, is transferring to another school an option right now?

dialogue.content: うーん、それは考えたことなかった。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I hadn't thought about that.

dialogue.content: もしくは、少し極端だけど、学校に行かない、というのも一つの選択肢かもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Or, and this might be a bit extreme, not going to school might also be an option.

dialogue.content: 帰国子女とか以外で半端な時期にできるのかな、、
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's possible at an odd time like this, unless you're a returnee student or something...

dialogue.content: 学校にいかないと、高校受験にひびく。内申点とか。
dialogue.English: If I don't go to school, it will affect my high school entrance exams. My school report, and things like that.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、義務教育だもんね。。
dialogue.English: You're right, it's compulsory education...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまうのですが、みかさんが今日お話ししてくれたようなことをもう一度ご両親とお話ししてみてもらって、一緒にできることやどう変えていけるかを考えてもらった上で、学校の先生とお話ししてもらうと良いのではないかと思いました。今日お話ししてみてどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: We're running out of time, but I was thinking it might be a good idea for you to talk with your parents again about the things you've told me today, have them think about what you can do together and how things can be changed, and then have them talk with your teacher. How did you feel about our talk today?

dialogue.content: 親には話したけど、特にお父さんがずれてるというか、わたしの気持ちがわからないみたい。
dialogue.English: I’ve talked to my parents, but my dad in particular is out of touch; it's like he doesn’t understand how I feel.

dialogue.content: もう一度先生に話す気にはなれないけど、考えてみます
dialogue.English: I don’t feel like talking to the teacher again, but I’ll think about it.

dialogue.content: でも今日はわかってくれる人がいてよかったです
dialogue.English: But I’m glad there was someone today who understands.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね、お父さんとの気持ちのづれがあったんだね。みかさんならきっとこの状況を打破できると思うので、もう一度お父さんとお話ししてみてくださいね。また相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: I see, so there was a disconnect with your father. I'm sure someone like you can overcome this situation, so please try talking with your father again. Please come and talk with me again anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: うんうん、いつでもお話し聞くのでまた来てくださいね！
dialogue.English: Of course, I'm always here to listen, so please come back anytime!

dialogue.content: （今日はありがとうございました。時間少し過ぎてしましすみません！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I’m sorry we ran a little over time!)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ今日はありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well for today.)

dialogue.content: （大変勉強になりました。忌憚ないFBをお願いいたします。終了ボタン押させて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience. Please give me your candid feedback. I will now press the end button.)
